page.overview:
What is Sabbra Cadabra?

Sabbra Cadabra is the Disc 1 third song from 1998's album Garage, Inc. It was written by Ozzy Osbourne, Tony Iommi, Geezer Butler, and Bill Ward, with a length of 6:20.

This song includes an excerpt of A National Acrobat, and was originally released by Black Sabbath in 1973 on the Sabbath Bloody Sabbath album. Metallica's version was recorded in Sep-Oct 1998, at The Plant Studios in Sausalito, CA. Sabbra Cadabra also appears in the Die, Die My Darling single release on a live version, recorded on November 24, 1998 in New York, NY.

Feel so good, I feel so fine Love that little lady always on my mind She gives me loving every night and day Never gonna leave her, never going away

Someone to love me You know she makes me feel all right, yeah (all right) Someone to need me Love me every single night, yeah
